# Evans Ademilua

> Evans Ademilua is a full stack developer and web developer and the CEO of Large Technologies, based in Lagos, Nigeria. He is also known as Olufemi Evans Ademilua, Olufemi Ademilua and Evans Large. He builds websites, web apps, booking systems, client portals, internal dashboards, workflow automation and AI features for businesses. Top Rated on Upwork with eight 5-star client reviews.

## Key pages
- [Home and portfolio](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/): about, recent builds, how a project runs, and how to request an audit
- [Full stack developer for hire](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/full-stack-developer/): what he builds, the stack he uses and how to hire him
- [Web developer in Lagos, Nigeria](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/web-developer/): websites and web apps for businesses worldwide
- [Free online tools](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/): video, audio, PDF, image and QR code tools that run in the browser
- [Video editor](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/video-editor/): Cut, auto edit with captions and transitions, add text, music and filters, then export an MP4. Free in the browser, or install the app.
- [QR code generator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/qr-code-generator/): Links, text, WiFi, WhatsApp, email, phone, SMS, location and contact cards. Add a logo and colors.
- [Video compressor, converter and trimmer](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/video-tools/): Three video tools in one: shrink a big video, convert it to MP4, MP3, GIF and more, or cut it in seconds. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Second screen presenter](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/second-screen-presenter/): Bible verses, lyrics, PDFs, videos, cameras and countdowns on a TV or projector, with a stage display and phone remote.
- [File Share by Evans Large](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/send-app/): Send big files and folders between two computers over Wi-Fi. Install it on both. Windows, Mac and Linux.
- [Background remover](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/remove-background/): Remove the background from any image. Exact for logos, AI cutout for photos. Transparent PNG.
- [Audio by Evans Large](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/audio-mastering/): A music workstation: unlimited tracks, MIDI, plugins, spectral repair, noise removal and loudness mastering. Free in your browser, or install the app for Windows and Mac.
- [Large Lead Finder](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/large-lead-finder/): Find leads for any of 126 niches in any country, with a working email or an Instagram page on every lead and all their social media. Download a CSV or PDF, or files for the Outreach Mailer and IG Outreach. Windows.
- [QuizBlast live quizzes](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/quiz-live/): Make quizzes with 10 question types and play them live with a game PIN, on teams, or alone. Free, no account.
- [Outreach Mailer](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/mailer/): Up to 25 Gmail accounts at 150 emails a day each, with a full inbox, CSV and PDF lead upload, lead splitting by number, no repeat emails, and live sent, opened, replied and bounced stats. Windows.
- [IG Outreach](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/ig-outreach/): Send Instagram messages from up to 10 of your own accounts, 20 a day each, see who replies, and track the numbers for every account and for the whole outreach. Windows and Mac.
- [QR code scanner](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/qr-code-scanner/): Read a code from a photo, a screenshot or your camera. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Invoice and receipt generator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/invoice-receipt-generator/): Make an invoice or a receipt in one tool: 18 invoice designs and 33 receipt designs, with PDF, PNG and print. No sign-up, no watermark.
- [Choir Assistant](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/choir-assistant/): Play a keyboard with 5 sounds, find the key of a song, and see where the bass, chords, lead line and beat play in any song you upload.
- [Color picker](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/color-picker/): Pick any color on your screen, even outside the browser. Chrome extension and Windows and Mac app, plus palettes from photos and a contrast check.
- [Currency calculator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/currency-calculator/): Convert between about 160 currencies with live reference rates, a margin option and a pinned table.
- [Image converter and compressor](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/image-converter/): Convert HEIC, PNG, WebP, AVIF and more to JPG, PNG or WebP. Shrink images in batches.
- [PDF converter](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/pdf-converter/): Turn Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images and text into PDF, or PDF into JPG, Word, Excel and more. Merge, split and compress.
- [Screen recorder](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/screen-recorder/): Record your screen, a window or a tab with sound. Free in the browser, or install the Windows and Mac app to record any app. Saved on your computer.
- [Watermark maker](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/watermark-maker/): Add a text or logo watermark to one or many photos. Tile it or place it, then download a ZIP.
- [Solutions](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/solutions.html): nine systems he builds, what each does and how it benefits the owner
- [CareTRAC case study](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/work/caretrac.html): field and client coordination portal (FastAPI, React)
- [Sky Team Ife case study](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/work/sky-team-ife.html): operations dashboard (Vercel, Supabase)

## Skills
Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, n8n workflow automation, LLM API integration (OpenAI, Claude), Bubble.io, FlutterFlow.
